title: 跳高记录
problem_statement_md:
目前跳高的世界纪录是2.45米。
给定一个程序，输入数字，代表跳高高度。

完成以下任务：
1. 如果数字**大于**2.45，则向控制台输出**new record**。
2. 否则在控制台输出**not this time**。
problem_statement_en_md:
[s0l0!-header][h1]The if else statement[/h1][/s0l0!-header]

The current world record for high jumping is 2.45 meters.
You are given a program that receives as input a number that represents the height of the jump.

[b]Task[/b]
Complete the code to:
1. output to the console [b]"new record"[/b] if the number is [b]more than 2.45[/b],
2. output to the console [b]"not this time" [/b]in other cases.

[b]Sample Input[/b]
2.49

[b]Sample Output[/b]
new record

[note]Note that if the jump height is equal to 2.45 meters, it's not a new world record.[/note]
hint_md: 注意，如果跳跃高度等于2.45米，就不是新的世界纪录。
